stem: How did the concerns depicted in this cartoon affect the food industry?
instruction: Study the cartoon and answer the question that follows.

options.label: A
options.text: The food industry increased the cost of products in order to pay for chemical additives.

options.label: B
options.text: The federal government regulated the food industry in order to protect the health of the public.

options.label: C
options.text: The food industry imported more goods from Europe in order to offer customers more choices.

options.label: D
options.text: The federal government passed antitrust legislation in order to increase competition in the food industry.

visual_elements: The cartoon shows a man using various labeled devices testing food items labeled SAND EXTRACTOR, BUTTER TESTER, SUGAR, HASH, PURE ORANGE CO. MILK, MILK TESTER, CHEMISTRY, HIGH WATER MARK.
